title: v5.3.1 — Matrix Rain, Share Card Fix & More
message: Matrix background now has animated falling code rain instead of static grid lines. Share card renders crisp on high-DPI screens with version number repositioned. QR codes auto-link — scanning one opens the app and adds the friend automatically. Weekly mission reset notification added. Notification channels fixed — each category now appears as its own toggle in Android notification settings instead of being grouped under Other. APK info card added to About section.
